exercises.title: Fix: sum_evens
exercises.prompt: This function should return the sum of all even numbers. It returns the wrong answer. Find the bug and fix it.
exercises.hint: Look at how total is assigned inside the loop. Should it overwrite or add?

exercises.title: Fix: get_item
exercises.prompt: This function should return the item at the given index. It crashes with an IndexError. Fix it so it returns None if the index is out of range.
exercises.hint: Wrap the code in a try/except block, or check the length of the list first.

exercises.title: Fix: mutable default
exercises.prompt: This function should add an item to a list. Calling it twice should not share the same list. Fix the bug.
exercises.hint: Never use [] as a default argument. Use None instead, and create the list inside the function.

exercises.title: Fix: truthiness trap
exercises.prompt: This function should return 'Zero' if the number is 0, otherwise 'Not zero'. It currently returns 'Zero' for False, but crashes or gives wrong results for 0. Fix the logic.
exercises.hint: Use `num == 0` explicitly instead of `not num`. Truthiness treats 0, False, and empty strings the same.

exercises.title: Fix: infinite loop
exercises.prompt: This function should count down from a number to 1. It currently runs forever. Fix the bug.
exercises.hint: Look at the loop body. Is `n` ever changing?

exercises.title: Fix: logic bug
exercises.prompt: This function should return the largest number in the list. It returns the last number instead. Fix it.
exercises.hint: You are checking if n > best, but you forgot to actually update `best`.
